datasets.description: Cameroon Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2020. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cameroon_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2020]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (monthly) field assessments across Cameroon in 2020 to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Results were spatially coded by administrative unit and scenario, with classifications standardized across multiple collection dates from February through December 2020.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity severity and geographic extent.
